title: Second Mode
paragraphs: After returning triumphantly to Melromarc from Faubrey under the pretext of investigating the case, we had an audience with the queen, and Father’s innocence was officially proven that very same day. It was toward the end of that evening reception.
“Boo! Mer-chan!”
“Hey there, Spear Hero, Filo-chan clearly doesn’t want this. Even if you’re the Spear Hero, I can’t just stand by and watch you chase after someone who’s clearly uncomfortable.”
“Guh… You Finacée! Filo-tan is just playing around, that’s all…!”
I find myself in a heated argument with my Finacée, who has somehow ended up clinging to Filo-chan. How is it that my Finacée can get along with Filo-chan so effortlessly?
Could this be the power of fate? As expected of my Finacée. But I won’t be outdone!
“That Motoyasu is arguing without even laying a hand on her…”
“He called her ‘my Finacée,’ you know.”
“I see. He’s the one with a special bond to Filo, and he knows that if he makes a move, she’ll end up hating him.”
I turned toward the voice and saw my future Father standing there. Well, well, Father, you’ve come at just the right time.
“This is perfect timing. Father, could you please tell my Finacée not to interfere too much with Filo and my romantic moments?”
“Hmm… If I recall correctly, you’re that queen’s daughter—the second princess, right?”
“Uh, yes…”

Father-in-law and my Finacée’s gazes met. Under Father-in-law’s piercing stare, my Finacée’s expression softened slightly. I suspect she feels a sense of guilt over what Crimson Swine did to Father-in-law. It’s incredibly frustrating, but my Finacée is a thoughtful person, after all. To that Finacée, Father said:
“It seems you and Filo get along quite well. Regardless of your status as the Hero, would you mind becoming good friends with her?”
Hearing that, the Finacée looks completely bewildered. W-what does that mean? Father is acting as a bridge between the Finacée and Filo-chan.
“It’s a position where one’s mental fatigue tends to show easily.”

Father gently showed my Finacée what was under Filo-tan’s robe. It’s a veil of seduction, isn’t it? I want to see it too. I want to see it too. I tried desperately to turn my head and neck to catch a glimpse, but Father blocked my view.
“Wait a minute…”
“You know how stress can lead to behavior like this? I’ve tried to support her as much as I could, but there’s just no getting around *that*…”
*That*? What exactly is *that*? If Filo-chan is in danger, I, Motoyasu, will do whatever it takes to resolve this. That’s right. For now, I’ll make some Yggdrasil potion!
“O-okay. If the Shield Hero asks me to, I’ll do what I can… Filo-chan.”
“What?”
“You can’t do things like this anymore.”
What exactly is “this kind of thing”? Ugh… I’m so curious I can’t stand it!
“Ehh, but it feels so good when I do it?”
“Think about it carefully, Filo-chan. Who’s going to pick up the feathers you lose? And sniff them?”
“Huh!? No way! What should I do?”

Pick up the feathers she loses? Don’t worry, Filo-tan. As long as they’re within my line of sight, I’ll be the one collecting all of your shed feathers, Filo-chan, so they’ll never end up in the hands of any suspicious characters.

“First, you’ll have to hold off until they’ve all grown back. After that, you’ll need to be really careful. At the very least, don’t pull them out. You know I’m not saying this because I don’t like you, right?”
“……Yeah.”
Taking her Finacée’s advice to heart, Filo-chan nodded obediently. Soon after, her future Father, who had been watching the scene, spoke to Filo-chan.
“Filo.”
“What?”
“Get along with the Second Princess. If you play your cards right, you might be able to escape from that situation.”
Filo-tan is looking at me. So I’ll give her a beaming smile. Yeah! Yeah!
“Okay! Mel-chan, let’s be friends! Let’s play together!”
“Eek! Wait a minute, Filo-chan!?”
“Dash!”
In the end, Filo-chan went out with my Finacée. I can’t let my Finacée beat me here. I have to earn Filo-chan’s friendship points and win.
“Ah! Please wait for me, Filo-chan!”
“Motoyasu, you still have unfinished business with me!”
Ugh… Father stopped me. Father’s orders are absolute. It’s incredibly painful, but I’ll have to endure it.
“It’s great that my false accusations and all that got cleared up at once… but as a result, the schedule for the waves arriving has sped up tremendously, and now I’m stuck with even more of them.”
“The gaps left by Ren and Itsuki seem pretty big. But with me and Lady Filolial and the others, it’s not impossible!”
After all, there’s no obstacle Father can’t overcome.
“You’re just needlessly optimistic… even though this sounds like a losing battle…”
“The important thing is never to give up on anything.”

“Yeah, yeah. So… Motoyasu, next up is an event on an island called Carmira, and after that, the Spirit Tortoise… We’ll have to minimize the damage and squeeze in the reconstruction of Raphtalia’s village in between…”
“There’s still plenty to do, isn’t there?”

If we could bring the Tiger siblings to Zeltoble before that Trash causes any trouble, maybe we could manage things a bit better? That’s the kind of mindset Father and the others had as they steadily moved forward, drawing on my knowledge.

As for Carmira Island, needless to say... Since the Spirit Tortoise revives on its own, my Older Sister and I joined forces to sink it the moment it appeared. By this point, creatures like the Phoenix and the Qilin—without Takt—weren’t even a threat anymore. We’ve also more or less finished off the group that seemed to be reincarnated… things are going smoothly indeed.
My Older Sister’s village is also in the midst of full-scale reconstruction. It was quite impressive how Keel stood his ground, trying to protect the house where he used to live.
“Keel, that house is beyond repair. It’s not livable, and it’s dangerous. Please understand what Luna is saying.”

Luna-chan is holding Keel—who’s desperately trying to protect the house—and gently admonishing him. How kind of her. Luna-chan has grown into such a kind-hearted child who truly understands other people’s feelings…
“But this house is full of precious memories of my family.”
“…Do you really want to protect this house and live here that much?”
“Yeah!”
“Then I’ll live here with you so nothing happens and you don’t get hurt, Keel. We’ll stay together forever, nestled in Luna’s feathers—”
“Mom! Dad! I won’t forget any of you! This house is important to me, but I’ll tear it down and rebuild it into a new one that can protect everyone!”
Seeing Keel like that, Father grunted in admiration, calling it an amazing feat. “Is that really okay with you?”
“Yes… a dream house filled with all the cute moments of Luna and Keel-kun.”
“That’s not what I meant! Luna really never strays from her path, does she!”

And so, the settlement progressed without a hitch. By the way, it seems Siltvelt was secretly trying to send us some dragons and such, but since there are so many Filolials in the village, it was deemed a potential source of conflict, so they were resold and disposed of.
We don’t need dragons or anything like that!

That said, my Older Sister’s Older Sister might have made some acquaintances, so they might actually come in handy. We’ve managed to keep our distance, so there’s no room for our rivals to muscle in. Staying vigilant is a pain, though.
I hereby propose the “Dragons Are Unnecessary” theory. As for the Trash, once we introduced the Tiger siblings—who’d been healed—to the dejected Trash, they calmed down quite a bit.
It happened one day like this.
“Filo-tan! Father! It’s finally complete!”

I decided to immediately show off the finished custom tires to Filo-tan and Father. I’ve been researching day and night to develop these newly created, custom-made tires, perfectly suited for drive mode! As luck would have it, I’m here with Father, Big Sister, Filo-tan, and—though she’s not happy about it—my Finacée.
“Yay! Here they are!”
Philo-tan is trying to hide behind my Finacée. They’re here! It looks like they’re happy about it, which makes me really glad.
“What is it, Motoyasu?”
“I’ve finally finished my special tires!”
“Special, huh? I’m not sure I’m impressed by something that’s just a recreation of rubber tires… though I do see there’s a frame attached.”
“They look a bit like bicycle tires, don’t they?”

In this world, bicycles—popularized by the hero—do exist, mind you. However, since they’re a bit of a hassle to maintain, horse-drawn carriages and the like are more common. I think another reason is that, with the exception of a few countries and regions, there aren’t many paved roads designed for bicycles.
“This is a new-concept part I devised so I can ride in long-distance drive mode.”
By the way, I’ve brought the frame here on my back. At first glance, it probably looks like a chair.
“But before that—are you still going to do that?”
“I thought it would be necessary for long-distance touring with Lady Filolial, not to mention with Filo-tan. Besides, regular drive mode has various drawbacks.”

Since both hands and feet are occupied, it’s difficult to make precise movements. If Filo-tan does something like drifting, I have to turn sharply as well. Plus, since I can only see straight ahead, I can’t fully enjoy the sight of Filo-tan riding with me. That was the biggest drawback we discovered when carrying Filolial in Drive Mode. So, to solve that problem, I’ve prepared this frame and these tires.

The tires are designed to maximize speed while minimizing damage as much as possible. Wooden tires have their limits, you see. Our design philosophy is based on how to maintain Drive Mode for extended periods without breaking anything and how to navigate any rough terrain. That’s why we chose rubber tires—it’s all part of that consideration.
“…… “I don’t think there’s a problem with Drive Mode itself, though.”
“So, what are you going to do with this?”

My Finacée is frowning as she comments on the custom tires and frame. Hahaha! She’s really walking into the Fire, isn’t she? It seems she’s studied Filolial’s preferences a bit, but she’s still got a long way to go.
“Well then, it’s time for the unveiling! Watch this, Filo-tan! Behold my heroic form! Drive Mode: Second! Here we go!”

I leaped high into the air and summoned the Floating Spear—a spear version of the floating shield Father used to use—and threaded it through the custom tires. Like Ren, I’m not that skilled with this kind of floating gear, but since I’m only giving simple commands this time, it’s no problem. I connected it to the frame and landed on my back. Of course, I’ve also attached spears—which serve as the tire axles—to my feet.
“Whoa…”
“Eek…”
Father, Big Sister, and Fiancée all gasped in unison. Just as I expected. The reaction’s not half bad.
In other words, by staying in this position, I can keep my eyes on the face of whoever’s riding me. This isn’t like a recumbent bike—as that pig who knows all about bike racing told me.

And by having the rider grip my hands instead of handlebars, I can minimize the risk of them falling off to the absolute minimum. After all, this world has plenty of rough roads. Fall prevention is crucial!
And best of all, it’s a ride where we interlock our fingers! Oh… I’ve got to give myself a big thumbs-up for this idea. I want to hold hands with Filo-tan like lovers!
“Transformation complete! I say.”
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
Filo-tan let out a scream again. She’s got an urge to start running right now, doesn’t she?
“What do you think, Father? This is perfect, isn’t it!”
“So where are you taking Filo… no, is this like a ‘Hi-Ace’ situation?”
“What’s a ‘Hi-Ace’?”
It’s kind of a cool-sounding word. I bet it’s a ‘High Ace.’ Since I’m a high-energy hero, I’m an ace too! I’m ahead of my time! From now on, I’m a Hi-Ace!
“By the way, this is where Filo-tan and Father will ride.”

I tap my belly a couple of times to make it rumble. Thanks to my now-free hands, I can perform precise maneuvers. By the way, while in Second Mode, I can summon a new spear and advance while defeating enemies ahead! Similarly, I can activate Skills… like using Brionac, for example.
Before long, Father approached me without saying a word. This means… he’s going to ride me! It’s a truly moving riding scene!
“Here, right here, Father!”
I said that and beckoned to Father. And then—suddenly, he gave the rear wheel a powerful kick.
“Whoa!”
I almost lost my balance and was just about to regain my footing when…
“Shield Prison X!”
Without missing a beat, Father trapped me—just as I was trying to regain my balance—inside a shield cage. In this position, I can’t move forward or backward!
“Father! What on earth are you doing all of a sudden!?”
I couldn’t hear a response to my voice.
“Hey! Hurry up!”
“But—”
“Just do it already!”
“Yes! If we keep this up, he’s going to start running with *that*!”
My Finacée is yelling something. HAHAHA! I haven’t even done a test run yet.
So that’s it, then. They must have hidden me so they could reveal me to everyone. I’m so excited! Well then, I’m going to make a grand entrance to show everyone!

I tilt my head back… and cast Magic while checking my aim. After all, I trained myself to be able to cast Magic from my hands just for this. Thanks to this, I can now deal with monsters in ways other than just knocking them back. Of course, I can also attach a spear to my thigh and take aim as an “Aiming Lancer.” It’s a combat bike, you know!
“Drifa Rabbit Fire V!”

I’ll fire Magic at the ceiling of the shield cage that Father created… and make a spectacular appearance! I’ll race up the shield cage and escape. Then I’ll land on the ground. And to really amp up the cool factor, I’ll do a wheelie!
“It’s a wheelieeeeeeeeeee!”
…Huh? Aside from Father-in-law and Filo-tan and the others, there’s no audience. Was I a little too early?
“Is this enough for our rehearsal?”

As I looked over at Father-in-law, Filo-tan had transformed into her Filolial form, and Father-in-law was hurriedly climbing onto her back to help Big Sister get on. To my surprise, my finacée is clinging to the back of Filo-tan’s head. It’s frustrating, but they actually seem to look kind of good together.
“Damn it! She’s already come out!”
“Big Sis!”
“Raphtalia, hurry!”
“Y-yes! Drifa Mirage!”

Huh? As my Older Sister cast Magic, countless versions of Filo-chan—each carrying one of Fathers—appeared. Woaaaaaaah! It’s paradise! There are so many Filo-chans, wooooooaaah! Even if they’re illusions, there’s no way I can make them disappear!
“Go! Hurry up!”
In unison with Father’s voice, the Filo-chans took off running! W-which one is the real Filo-chan!? While I was trying to decide, the Filo-chans scattered in all directions.
I see—so next, they’ve decided to test Second Mode’s speed! I don’t know which one is the real one, but I’m going after them!
“Vroom, vroom!”

Spinning my tires at high speed, I chase after Father and the others. Eventually, perhaps because my Older Sister’s Magic wore off, one of the Filo-tans vanished in a flash. So I’m going to rely on her scent to chase after Fathers. And just like that, a game of tag with Fathers began.
“W-what’s that!? The Spear Hero!?”
“Could it be that the Shield Heroes were running away with such fierce expressions!?”
“Oh my… Naofumi-chan and the gang are having quite a bit of fun, aren’t they?”

It seems Keel and my Older Sisters are watching me and cheering me on. So I gave a bright smile and gave them a thumbs-up. That’s a huge difference from my first form, when all I could do was smile! If I want to, I can even drive while eating.
“Hey, Spear Guy. Even if you look all proud, it just makes things harder for us…”
That’s what Keel said, but he walked away before I could even reply. I’ll ask him later exactly what the problem was. For now, my top priority is chasing after Filo-chan and Father.

After that, Filo-tan and Father kept running away from me, even using their portal Skills at times to teleport all over the place to evade me. This is… exactly what I’ve been telling everyone—a durability test for Second Mode.
